code:
-- [본래 Studio 전투 점검] 최초 게임 화면을 숨기고 원본 FieldScene·공용 모션만 사용한다.
local pl=game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer
local pg=assert(pl:FindFirstChild('PlayerGui'),'WEAPON_QA_NO_PLAYER_GUI')
for _,g in pg:GetChildren() do if g:IsA('ScreenGui') then g.Enabled=false end end
workspace:SetAttribute('DevGod',true)
workspace:SetAttribute('DevAllies',true)
workspace:SetAttribute('VoyageActive',true)
return 'WEAPON_QA_INITIALIZED'

-- [시작: fist] 마지막 탐험은 정식 철수로 복귀시키고 신규 현장의 오류를 숨기지 않는다.
local gate=workspace:FindFirstChild('MareWeaponQAExit')
if gate then
 assert(gate:IsA('BindableFunction'),'WEAPON_EXIT_INVALID')
 gate:Invoke()
 gate:Destroy()
 assert(not workspace:FindFirstChild('FieldScene'),'WEAPON_PREVIOUS_SCENE_LEAK:fist')
 assert(not game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild('FieldGui'),'WEAPON_PREVIOUS_HUD_LEAK:fist')
end
assert(not workspace:FindFirstChild('FieldScene'),'WEAPON_UNOWNED_SCENE:fist')
workspace:SetAttribute('WeaponQAState','RUNNING:fist')
workspace:SetAttribute('VoyageActive',true)
local FS=require(game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage').Shared.FieldScene)
task.spawn(function()
 local ok,result=xpcall(function() return FS.start({ name='카리브 해적 소굴',portId='havana',nodes=2,danger=3,seed=5,weapon='fist',battleLevel=1,onFinish=function()end}) end,function(e) return debug.traceback(tostring(e)) end)
 if not ok or type(result)~='table' or type(result.finish)~='function' then
  workspace:SetAttribute('WeaponQAState','FAIL:fist:'..tostring(result):sub(1,360))
  return
 end
 local exit=Instance.new('BindableFunction')
 exit.Name='MareWeaponQAExit'
 exit.OnInvoke=function() result.finish('retreat') end
 exit.Parent=workspace
 workspace:SetAttribute('WeaponQAState','PASS:fist')
end)
return 'WEAPON_QA_LAUNCHED:fist'

-- [무기 fist] 실제 장착 상태·스킬 버튼·1~5단 승인 모션을 생성·샘플링해 검증한다.
local state
for i=1,65 do
 state=workspace:GetAttribute('WeaponQAState')
 if state=='PASS:fist' or (type(state)=='string' and string.sub(state,1,5)=='FAIL:') then break end
 task.wait(.2)
end
assert(state=='PASS:fist','WEAPON_FIELD_BUILD_FAILED:fist:'..tostring(state))
local pl=game.Players.LocalPlayer
local ch=assert(pl.Character,'WEAPON_HERO_MISSING:fist')
local root=assert(ch:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart'),'WEAPON_ROOT_MISSING:fist')
assert(workspace:FindFirstChild('FieldScene'),'WEAPON_SCENE_MISSING:fist')
assert(workspace:GetAttribute('FieldCombatReady')==true,'WEAPON_COMBAT_NOT_READY:fist')
local gui=assert(pl.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild('FieldGui'),'WEAPON_HUD_MISSING:fist')
assert(gui.Enabled,'WEAPON_HUD_DISABLED:fist')
assert(ch:GetAttribute('EquippedWeaponId')=='fist','WEAPON_ID_MISMATCH:fist:'..tostring(ch:GetAttribute('EquippedWeaponId')))
assert(gui:FindFirstChild('FieldHeroStatus'),'WEAPON_HERO_STATUS_MISSING:fist')
local family='fist'
local W=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Weapons)
local FM=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Shared.FieldMotion)
local weapon=W.get('fist')
local design=W.actionDesign(weapon)
assert(weapon.family==family and design.heavyBeat>=1 and design.sweepBeat>=1,'WEAPON_SKILL_MOTION_MAPPING_INVALID:fist')
for _,skill in {'heavy','sweep'} do
 local button=assert(gui:FindFirstChild('FieldSkill_'..skill,true),'WEAPON_SKILL_BUTTON_MISSING:fist:'..skill)
 local caption=assert(button:FindFirstChild('FieldSkillCaption'),'WEAPON_SKILL_TEXT_MISSING:fist:'..skill)
 local expected=if skill=='heavy' then design.heavy else design.sweep
 assert(caption.Text==expected,'WEAPON_SKILL_TEXT_WRONG:fist:'..skill..':'..tostring(caption.Text))
end
-- [무료 정밀 모션검사] 기존 공용 무기 모션을 1~10타·각 25프레임에서 직접 샘플링한다.
-- 클립 관절의 유효성·프레임별 큰 튐만 판정한다. 사진 감성·미술 품질은 검증했다고 주장하지 않는다.
local motionFrames, movedChannels, largestStep = 0, {}, 0
for stage=1,10 do
 local combo=FM.weaponCombo(if family=='fist' then 'UNARMED_RUSH' else weapon.motion,stage)
 assert(combo and combo.duration>0,'WEAPON_MOTION_ATOM_MISSING:fist:'..stage)
 local previous
 for frame=0,24 do
  local pose={}
  FM.sample(combo,combo.duration*(frame/24),pose)
  if frame==12 then assert(next(pose)~=nil,'WEAPON_R15_POSE_MISSING:fist:'..stage) end
  for joint,cf in pose do
   if typeof(cf)=='CFrame' then
    local _,angle=cf:ToAxisAngle()
    assert(angle==angle and angle<math.huge,'WEAPON_MOTION_NONFINITE:fist:'..stage..':'..frame..':'..joint)
    if previous and previous[joint] then
     local _,jump=(previous[joint]:Inverse()*cf):ToAxisAngle()
     assert(jump==jump and jump<math.huge,'WEAPON_MOTION_NONFINITE:fist:'..stage..':'..frame..':'..joint)
     largestStep=math.max(largestStep,jump)
     assert(jump<=1.50,'WEAPON_MOTION_FRAME_JUMP:fist:'..stage..':'..frame..':'..joint..':'..tostring(jump))
     if jump>0.015 then movedChannels[joint]=true end
    end
   end
  end
  previous=pose
  motionFrames+=1
 end
end
local active=0
for _ in movedChannels do active+=1 end
assert(active>=2,'WEAPON_MOTION_MANNEQUIN:fist:'..active)

if family=='fist' then
 for _,style in {'UNARMED_UPPERCUT','UNARMED_KICK','UNARMED_ELBOW'} do
  assert(FM.weaponCombo(style,1),'WEAPON_FANTASY_UNARMED_SKILL_MISSING:'..style)
 end
end
ch:PivotTo(CFrame.new(3000,4,100))
root.Anchored=false
workspace:SetAttribute('ShotCF',CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(3000,20,128),Vector3.new(3000,4,101)))
workspace:SetAttribute('ShotFov',63)
return 'WEAPON_QA_READY:fist:STAGES_1_TO_10:MOTION_FRAMES='..motionFrames..':ACTIVE_JOINTS='..active..':MAX_JUMP='..string.format('%.3f',largestStep)

 local expected=if skill=='heavy' then design.heavy else design.sweep

-- [무료 정밀 모션검사] 기존 공용 무기 모션을 1~10타·각 25프레임에서 직접 샘플링한다.
-- 클립 관절의 유효성·프레임별 큰 튐만 판정한다. 사진 감성·미술 품질은 검증했다고 주장하지 않는다.
local motionFrames, movedChannels, largestStep = 0, {}, 0
for stage=1,10 do
 local combo=FM.weaponCombo(if family=='fist' then 'UNARMED_RUSH' else weapon.motion,stage)
 assert(combo and combo.duration>0,'WEAPON_MOTION_ATOM_MISSING:crossbow:'..stage)
 local previous
 for frame=0,24 do
  local pose={}
  FM.sample(combo,combo.duration*(frame/24),pose)
  if frame==12 then assert(next(pose)~=nil,'WEAPON_R15_POSE_MISSING:crossbow:'..stage) end
  for joint,cf in pose do
   if typeof(cf)=='CFrame' then
    local _,angle=cf:ToAxisAngle()
    assert(angle==angle and angle<math.huge,'WEAPON_MOTION_NONFINITE:crossbow:'..stage..':'..frame..':'..joint)
    if previous and previous[joint] then
     local _,jump=(previous[joint]:Inverse()*cf):ToAxisAngle()
     assert(jump==jump and jump<math.huge,'WEAPON_MOTION_NONFINITE:crossbow:'..stage..':'..frame..':'..joint)
     largestStep=math.max(largestStep,jump)
     assert(jump<=1.50,'WEAPON_MOTION_FRAME_JUMP:crossbow:'..stage..':'..frame..':'..joint..':'..tostring(jump))
     if jump>0.015 then movedChannels[joint]=true end
    end
   end
  end
  previous=pose
  motionFrames+=1
 end
end
local active=0
for _ in movedChannels do active+=1 end
assert(active>=2,'WEAPON_MOTION_MANNEQUIN:crossbow:'..active)

if family=='fist' then
 for _,style in {'UNARMED_UPPERCUT','UNARMED_KICK','UNARMED_ELBOW'} do
  assert(FM.weaponCombo(style,1),'WEAPON_FANTASY_UNARMED_SKILL_MISSING:'..style)
 end
end
ch:PivotTo(CFrame.new(3000,4,100))
root.Anchored=false
workspace:SetAttribute('ShotCF',CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(3000,20,128),Vector3.new(3000,4,101)))
workspace:SetAttribute('ShotFov',63)
return 'WEAPON_QA_READY:crossbow:STAGES_1_TO_10:MOTION_FRAMES='..motionFrames..':ACTIVE_JOINTS='..active..':MAX_JUMP='..string.format('%.3f',largestStep)
